The most recent accepted result is attempt-0087/micro-0001 at 1703 parameters and 99.020000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0086/micro-0001 (discard, 3.820000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 151 and 240, values 0.0027043121 and 0.0028148380 (difference 1.105e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,702 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.121e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map.
